 Who we are 
 CAI is a global services firm with over 9,000 associates worldwide and a yearly revenue of $1.3 billion+. We have over 40 years of excellence in uniting talent and technology to power the possible for our clients, colleagues, and communities. As a privately held company, we have the freedom and focus to do what is right—whatever it takes. Our tailor-made solutions create lasting results across the public and commercial sectors, and we are trailblazers in bringing neurodiversity to the enterprise.
 
 Job Summary 
As a Smile CDR Integration Developer, you will design, develop, and support enterprise interoperability solutions that enable healthcare data exchange across payer, provider, and regulatory platforms. 
 Job Description 
 We are seeking a Smile CDR Integration Developer to design, develop, and support enterprise interoperability solutions that enable healthcare data exchange across payer, provider, and regulatory platforms. This role will focus on building scalable integrations utilizing Smile CDR, Apache Camel, FHIR APIs, PySpark, JavaScript, and modern integration technologies. The candidate will play a critical role in delivering CMS Interoperability, Prior Authorization, Provider Access, Payer-to-Payer, and BCBSA interoperability solutions. This position is short-term contract and remote. 
 What You’ll Do 
 Design and develop Smile CDR integrations and FHIR-based solutions
 Develop Apache Camel routes and integration services
 Build and support API integrations with internal and external systems
 Develop ETL and data ingestion pipelines using PySpark and Python
 Create scalable healthcare interoperability solutions utilizing HL7 FHIR standards
 Consume and publish REST APIs across enterprise platforms
 Develop and maintain JavaScript-based Smile CDR modules and automation components
 Collaborate with architects and business stakeholders to translate requirements into technical solutions
 Support testing, deployment, monitoring, and production support activities
 Participate in architecture reviews, code reviews, and technical design sessions
 Create technical documentation, data mappings, and integration specifications
 What You'll Need 
 Required:
 Minimum 5 years of software development experience in Python/PySpark, Java, JavaScript, Apache Camel, REST APIs, JSON, XML, and SQL
 Experience with healthcare interoperability standards (FHIR/HL7)
 Experience consuming and developing APIs
 Strong understanding of distributed integration architectures
 Experience with ETL and data engineering practices
 Preferred:
 Smile CDR development experience
 HL7 FHIR R4 expertise
 CMS Interoperability experience
 Prior Authorization, Payer-to-Payer, or Provider Access experience
 Databricks experience
 Hadoop ecosystem experience
 GitLab CI/CD experience
 Healthcare payer domain experience
  Physical Demands 
 Ability to safely and successfully perform the essential job functions consistent with the ADA and other federal, state and local standards
 Sedentary work that involves sitting or remaining stationary most of the time with occasional need to move around the office to attend meetings
 Ability to conduct repetitive tasks on a computer, utilizing a mouse, keyboard, and monitor
